beats.speaker: Edda
beats.line: No one saw it. No blade found, no poison named, no enemy at the gates. They found him in his chamber, our king.

beats.speaker: Edda
beats.line: I thought that was the worst of it. I was wrong.

beats.speaker: Edda
beats.line: Within a season, people began to vanish. Not dead, not fled. Gone. And here's the part that keeps me up at night...

beats.speaker: Edda
beats.line: They call me mad, you know.

beats.speaker: Edda
beats.line: I'm not the only one. There are a few of us. We find each other, quietly.

beats.speaker: Edda
beats.line: Those who lost someone dear, and remember. Some say they feel them still. A warmth in an empty chair. A voice in the wind through the rafters. A light in the eyes of a stranger that was never theirs. As if the soul refuses to be forgotten, even when the world has agreed to forget.

beats.speaker: Edda
beats.line: Don't pity me, traveler. If I'm the last to remember them, then they're not truly gone. That's something. That's... Hm. Strange. My hands feel so light.

beats.speaker: Edda
beats.line: Ah. So it's my turn. If anyone asks... tell them Edda was real...

bookBeats.speaker: Yard Ledger
bookBeats.line: Edda's hand. Names the chalk line still knows, even when mouths forget.

bookBeats.speaker: Yard Ledger
bookBeats.line: The king died in his chamber. No blade. No poison named. No enemy at the gates.

bookBeats.speaker: Yard Ledger
bookBeats.line: Within a season, people vanished. Not dead. Not fled. Gone — and the yard forgot their faces.

bookBeats.speaker: Yard Ledger
bookBeats.line: A few of us remember. We find each other quietly. If you carry this book, you carry their marks.

bookBeats.speaker: Yard Ledger
bookBeats.line: Cinder Gate is shut beyond the chalk. Do not let the yard go blank again.
